description: This file defines a dialog plugin for CKEditor that manages textarea elements, allowing users to insert or modify textarea tags with configurable attributes such as 'name', 'cols', and 'rows'.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog when shown, loading existing textarea element data if editing.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the creation or modification of the textarea element when the dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Initializes dialog fields based on the existing textarea element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Commits the dialog input values to the textarea element.
